inputs.causal_hypothesis: AI-reduced design friction may expand printer adoption and utilization, with consumables, scanners, multi-material systems, cloud, community, and creator economics potentially capturing more value than hardware units.
inputs.focused_questions: Test printer versus consumables growth, installed base, utilization, branded-material attachment and lock-in, Creality Cloud and creator economics, margins, customer concentration, post-IPO balance sheet, Bambu Lab pressure, scenarios, rating, invalidation, and exposure timing.

objective: Research and value Creality H shares as a consumer and prosumer 3D-printing ecosystem.
